notes.title: Hidden Update
notes.notes:
Hey community! 

We have noticed that this update has not been displayed despite being published and we think it is due to the space we have chosen to post it. So we are re-posting it in this category as well. 


During Gamescom we updated the demo/playtest of Movierooms. Sorry for the slightly late announcement, but the event was truly intense (and amazing!)💜. Here’s a look at what’s new and a little recap of our experience:

🔧 Update Highlights
📖 Improved Tutorial → clearer and guided step by step.

🎛️ UI Optimizations → better readability and usability.

🐛 Bug Fixes → resolved issues in levels 1900 and 1930, plus fixes in Sandbox mode.

A huge thanks to everyone sending us feedback and bug reports, you’re helping us make Movierooms better every day! ❤️


Gamescom 2025
We just returned from Gamescom, where Movierooms had its very own booth. It was an incredible experience: we met many of you in person, gathered valuable feedback, and felt the passion of the community. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who stopped by to discover Movierooms!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124695/05f1b2f3e9f8ff19f0136163c876ac6526c9a259.png"]

You can discover our 'travel diary' on video and find it on our social media! 


🎟️ Contest Reminder
For those who received a contest ticket during Gamescom: to confirm your participation, please leave us your feedback (positive or constructive). On Friday 26 September we will announce the 3 winners! 🍀

So, leave your feedback directly on Steam and raggiungeteci sul nostro canale Discord: 

https://discord.gg/vUquEGJ 



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45124695/107d3183dce522fcadf45b0883892847e4999432.png"]
🚀 What to do next
🎮 Update the demo and try out the new features

📝 Leave us a review or feedback

🔔 Stay tuned: we’re already working on the next summer/autumn features!



Thanks so much for your support and for being part of this journey 💜

The Mad Pumpkins Team 🎃

notes.title: Update Notes September 23rd
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you're all doing well. Here at Mad Pumpkins, we've kept pushing forward, and we announce a new update. This version is the one we plan to present at upcoming events. Here's a summary of the issues we've addressed:

Quality/Accessibility Updates
* Removed the Arcade Icon in the 1939 level (this feature isn't available in that era, but you will find it in later levels and in the SANDBOX mode).
* You can now create multiple rooms without needing to close and reopen the panel after each action.
* Construction pricing for rooms has been added.
* Left-clicking on room walls now activates new icons (call for cleaning, modify, move, and delete room).

Bug Fixes
* In some cases, customers did not arrive => For example in the 1900 level, the magic lantern with piano used to cause a blank screen with no film display and would result in no customers. => This has now been resolved!
* You can now create up to 5 rooms in the 1939 level (e.g., 3 screening rooms, a bathroom, and a staff break room).
* The customization panel, which was previously stuck, now allows you to change room floors and wall colors again.
* Similarly, wall creation and destruction now function properly.
* An issue where objects placed too close to a room's corner would delete part of the wall has been fixed.

Known bugs we are working on:
* Improvements in AI behaviour (e.g. the queue forming at the checkout in the sandbox), characters will do different activities 😉
* Resolution behaviour of the clients with 2 doors in the same room.
* Sometimes, we have the animation walk which continues instead of the animation stops or sits.
* Sometimes, if we move a stand or case in 1939, it is not any more taken into account by the NPCs.
* See a little gif info box the first time I build a new type of room.

Please let us know if your version has been updated and if you're now testing this cleaner version compared to the first one you tried. Thank you so much for all your help!
